concepts.description: A structural unit in the system architecture that encapsulates related components, types, interfaces, and functions.
A physical or logical platform that embodies robotic capabilities and interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined set of values or events through which components interact.
A component responsible for managing or coordinating system behavior based on inputs.
A basic data type predefined by the system, not composed of other types.
A user-defined data type composed of multiple fields of specified types.
A callable unit of behavior that performs a computation and may return a result.

instances.description: The main architectural module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform within the AUV system that uses sensor and actuator interfaces.
An interface providing access to sensor data such as depth, heading, and obstacle information.
An interface for controlling actuators; currently empty.
A controller handling operator-related inputs via the Inputs interface.
An interface defining input events such as task termination and mode requests.
A controller implementing the Last Response Engine logic using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defining output events such as velocity and heading commands.
A controller managing autopilot functionality using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing textual data.
A primitive type representing true/false values.
A primitive type representing real (floating-point) numbers.
A composite type representing a spherical vector with radial, polar, and azimuth components.
A composite type representing an obstacle with relative position, depth, ID, and heading.
An interface (note: likely typo for 'Inputs') defining input events including task control and data requests.
A composite type representing close proximity data with horizontal and vertical coordinates and an identifier.
A function that computes the Euclidean distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the horizontal distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
A function that computes the vertical distance from the AUV to a given obstacle.
